name: [[560,40,8]] periodic bivariate-bicycle on Z_20 x Z_14

provenance.construction: Periodic bivariate-bicycle code on the group algebra Z_20 x Z_14 (n = 2*l*m = 560). Convention: x = S_20 tensor I_14, y = I_20 tensor S_14 (cyclic shifts), qubit index = i*m + j; A = 1 + x^0y^11 + x^7y^2 + x^7y^8, B = 1 + x^0y^1; H_X = [A|B], H_Z = [B^T|A^T]. Found by an automated evolutionary/mutation search over (l, m, A, B) exponent sets targeting the unrestricted x weight-6 (or weight-8) board cells, screened by a randomized lightest-logical surrogate and promoted through increasing trial budgets.
provenance.notes: Internal autoresearch candidate id 45046 (canonical key 8eb759b13183f688ae6d8ae8), search lane 'high-distance-transfer', proposal kernel 'exact-geometry-grid'. Initial NumPy lightest-logical surrogate: trials=8000, seed=1231842118. Confirmed with an accelerated bit-packed random-information-set search at rung '1m' (1000000 trials, seed=1241659534, pair_depth=16), tightest witness on side X at weight 8. Distance also taken through an internal exact-certification pipeline (MILP, one solve per logical-basis row per side, the same method as this repository's own verify/certify.py).
